name: Weav
description: The Weav MCP Server gives Claude access to your customer conversations, customer records, and knowledge base. Support, product, and success teams can search real customer service tickets, draft replies, and keep agent training data current without leaving Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Weav to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Weav to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.weav.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Weav MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Weav provides these MCP tools: add_training_data, delete_training_data, get_conversation, get_customer, get_training_data, resync_training_data, search_conversations, search_customers, search_training_data, send_reply, and update_conversation.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Weav?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Weav in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Weav requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Weav is developed by Weav. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
